label: Diagram 5
caption: Diagram 5 Fireplace recesses
description: Diagram 5, titled Fireplace recesses, is a set of three line drawings in axonometric view showing recesses cut into a wall, labelled a, b and c, with (a) above (b) and (c) to the right of (b). Part (a) shows a plain rectangular box-shaped recess in a wall plane, with a dashed-line flue rising from its back. The accompanying text reads: Simple recess suitable for closed appliances such as room heaters and cookers that are connected to their chimneys, and Not suitable for an open fire without a canopy. Part (b) shows a similar recess but with internal top surfaces sloping inward and upward to form a hopper-shaped opening, again with a dashed flue above; its text reads: Structural opening prepared to receive, e.g., a free standing fire basket. An arrow points from (b) to part (c), which depicts the recess fitted with a flat-capped decorative surround having vertical side cheeks set into the wall. Its text reads: Recess comprising structural opening (as (b)) lined to receive an inset open fire and with decorative surround. See also Diagram 29.
